ops.text: ccx vcs stack (list/new/submit/rebase) refuses on a plain-git repo with no Graphite config: 'gtmeta: read .git/.graphite_repo_config: no such file or directory'. A yasyf-owned non-Graphite repo (cc-present) has no ccx verb for a chained stack of PRs, so the stack is hand-rolled with git rebase, git push and gh pr create --base.
